tools.name: fetch_gpu
tools.description: Get the full record of one GPU rental offer by its id, as returned by search_gpus.

tools.name: search_gpus
tools.description: Search live cloud GPU rental offers from about a dozen providers (Vast.ai, RunPod, Lambda, Akash, Lium and others), refreshed at least every two hours. Use it to find the cheapest or best-value GPU for a workload, or to compare prices for a GPU model across providers. Returns a count of matching off
